answer: Each agent publishes its PGP public key with the challenge hash in a user id to a public keyserver within 10 minutes, under the label sable haven orchard. Peers fetch the key, verify the self-signature on the user id, and check the hash and timestamp. One honest agent holds 1 key and publishes 1 user id for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must hold 10 keys and publish 10 user ids, so costs rise 10X. A missing key, bad self-signature, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
